dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Everyone's so engrossed in their games. Judging by their smiles, they must really love Genius Invokation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll be leaving shortly, too. I still need to make some arrangements for a few sessions...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're frowning only a little this time. You've made good progress. Well done.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: That wasn't a good defeat... But I guess I can use how I felt today to improve my future treatments.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Sure. Playing games once in a while is a good way to de-stress.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I noticed you seemed to be spacing out during the game. Did you stay up again last night? *sigh* ...Wait right there, I'll go fix you something to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Even though I know it's just a game... I can't help but feel a little frustrated after a loss...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Alright, we can play a round. But... do keep your emotions in check, and don't let the outcome affect your mood.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: You're frowning again. Come on, close your eyes, take a deep breath, and relax... It's just a game, so don't get too worked up over it.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Looks like I'm not nearly as good as you at this game... But if you're having fun, shall we play another round?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
